title: Canzoneri 2013 tool-use PPS reshaping
citation: Canzoneri, E., Ubaldi, S., Rastelli, V., Finisguerra, A., Bassolino, M., & Serino, A. (2013). Tool-use reshapes the boundaries of body and peripersonal space representations. Experimental Brain Research, 228, 25-42.
notes: Tool-use PPS plasticity profile. The publication reports an audio-tactile interaction task before and after use of a 1 m tool. This preload recreates the runnable PPS assessment task using the paper-reported method plus the delegated Canzoneri et al. (2012) protocol lineage: 3000 ms IN/OUT pink-noise sounds, T1-T5 tactile delays, T0/T6 tactile-only baselines, 76 auditory-only catches, and two paper blocks. The 20-minute physical tool-use and pointing-control interventions are retained as context rather than automated runner phases.

reference_parameters.reported_intervention: 1 m tool-use training before/after PPS measurement
reference_parameters.baseline_subtype: tactile-only T0/T6 timing controls during pre/post sound silence inherited from Canzoneri et al. (2012)
reference_parameters.response_rule: speeded response to tactile target, ignore sound
reference_parameters.analysis_outlier_rule: trim RTs exceeding 2 SD from participant/condition mean
reference_parameters.training_context: Experiment 1A measured PPS before and after 20 minutes of blindfolded right-hand tool use with a 1 m wooden stick; Experiment 3 used a pointing-control training task and found no PPS/BR shift.
remaining_caveats: exact original SoundForge pink-noise gain/envelope files and room transfer are not available
participant-level electrical tactile threshold calibration and voice-key threshold/latency are represented as provenance and emulated by mouse-click response proxies
the physical tool-use and pointing-control interventions are context tasks and are not automated as runner-controlled phases

metadata.electrical_stimulator_model: Digitimer DS7A or equivalent constant-current stimulator
metadata.electrical_electrode_site: hairy surface of the right forearm
metadata.source_asset_equivalence: procedural pink-noise proxy for unshared SoundForge files
metadata.renderer_equivalence_boundary: binaural virtual trajectory proxy for physical near/far loudspeaker intensity motion
metadata.iti_policy: fixed 1000 ms pre-sound and 1000 ms post-sound silence reported; runner uses source-timing metadata plus toolkit block spacing

provenance.source: Experimental Brain Research article reports PPS measured with an audio-tactile interaction task before and after using a 1 m tool.
The 2013 article says procedures were similar to Canzoneri et al. (2012); the profile inherits the 2012 dynamic-sound count, baseline, catch, and block contract.
2013 Methods report T1-T5 at 300, 800, 1500, 2200, and 2700 ms from sound onset, with tactile targets in 60% of trials and auditory-only catches in 40%.
2013 Results/Figure 3 report a post-tool-use shift of the fitted PPS central point toward far space; Experiment 3 pointing control reports no comparable shift.
